comments.author: Lisa
comments.body: has anybody found a good spot for collecting green ore here? I have tried all the landmarks and there is zero difference between right next to those and anywhere else in the zone I have tested. Haven't seen anything quite like it.

comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body:
The third treasure from the theme Those who Fought Rome is found here at the Diagonal Boulder furthest away, in the southwest corner.

Quest name: Genius Strategist, r7 Search, r9 Archaeology, Greek
Reward: Scrolls of Pyrrhus, 30 Durability, Tactics Effect, +2 Tactics, 5000 Total Fame Required
Also part of a new memorial album.

comments.author: Hawthorne
comments.body: Land investigation here requires a discovery, so bring a map or an adventure quest with you.

comments.author: Angelica
comments.body: The least bad spot for collecting green ore and beehives that I've found is the Diagonal Boulder in the Northwest. I was on the east side of the boulder facing it. Not great, but better than other places.
